anomaly_label: Overshooting pressure-control response of vacuum throttle valve (TV1)

evidence.observation: Rose sharply from ~69 to ~82.8 °C at k=18-19 then plateaued, consistent with vapour front reaching the upper column section
Smooth monotonic heat-up throughout, now levelling near 102-108 °C
Distillate and reflux flows increased together (0.29/0.62) as the front arrived; reflux ratio stable ~2

args.missing_evidence: Distillate composition (GC/refractive index) sample, and continued T712/T705 response to confirm the front advances to the top without flooding
